title: PLATO — Place Attestation Ontology: Core Definitions
description: Shared object-type definitions for the PLATO data model. These definitions are composed by the place-centric and attestation-centric submission profiles.

isoOrYear.description: ISO 8601 date/time or a signed integer year (e.g. '-0500' for 500 BCE).

unitFloat01.description: A value on the unit interval [0, 1].

qualification.description: Qualification properties applicable to any facet node: epistemic certainty, ontological fuzziness, or relativity to an anchor entity. All properties are optional.

certainty.description: Epistemic certainty: 0.0 = completely uncertain, 1.0 = completely certain. Better evidence could raise it; distinct from fuzziness.

certaintyNote.description: Explanation of the basis for the certainty value: quality of evidence, reliability of source, scholarly consensus.

fuzzinessNote.description: Explanation of the nature of ontological fuzziness.

relativeTo.description: URI of the anchor entity (SpatialEntity, Name, Period, etc.) to which this facet is defined relatively.

relativeBearing.description: Compass bearing from the anchor, in degrees.

relativeDistance.description: Distance from the anchor, in metres.

relativeQualifier.description: URI of a controlled-vocabulary term describing the relative relationship (e.g. plato:Near, plato:Within, plato:UpstreamOf).

name.description: A toponym or appellation. Reusable across attestations and SpatialEntities.

@id.description: Stable URI for this Name node, if it has one.

toponym.description: The name string in its original script.

nameType.description: Type(s) of name: toponym (place), chrononym (period), ethnonym (people), demonym (inhabitants), odonym (street), hydronym (water body).

romanized.description: Romanised/transliterated form if the toponym is in a non-Latin script.

ipa.description: International Phonetic Alphabet representation of pronunciation.

nameEmbedding.description: Vector embedding for phonetic similarity search (format: implementation-specific, typically 256-dimensional vector).

geometry.description: A spatial representation. Supports both WKT and GeoJSON formats, with precision metadata.

wkt.description: Well-Known Text representation of the geometry.

geojson.description: GeoJSON Geometry object (Point, Polygon, LineString, etc.). Note: GeometryCollection not supported in some implementations.

reprPoint.description: Representative point as [longitude, latitude]. Required for spatial indexing.

role.description: URI of a controlled-vocabulary concept stating what this geometry depicts: an extent, a feature point, a representative point standing in for the SpatialEntity, a label anchor. Orthogonal to spatialPrecision, which states how well the location is known rather than what it locates.

hull.description: Convex hull as WKT Polygon for quick spatial filtering.

propertyValue.description: An attribute of a SpatialEntity that is not a Name, Geometry, Timespan or Type: a population, a valuation, an elevation, a market's trading day. The property is identified by URI in an external vocabulary; the value is either a literal or a structured object whose shape is declared by valueType.

property.description: URI of the property in an external vocabulary (e.g. a Wikidata property, a CIDOC-CRM property, a project vocabulary term).

sourceLabel.description: The original wording in the contributing source, before mapping. For structured values this preserves the unparsed original, e.g. 'Monday after Whitsun, 3 days'.

value.description: The value. A literal (number, string, boolean) for scalar attributes, or an object for structured ones — in which case valueType should declare its shape.

datatype.description: Datatype of a literal value (e.g. xsd:integer). Omitted for structured values.

unit.description: URI of the unit of measurement, where the value has one. Omitted for counts and dimensionless values.

valueType.description: URI declaring the shape of a structured value, so a consumer can tell whether it understands the value before reading it. Omitted for literal values.

timespan.description: A temporal interval with explicit uncertainty bounds using a four-date model. Aligned with PeriodO best practices.

openStart.description: True if start is deliberately unspecified (not just unknown).

openEnd.description: True if end is deliberately unspecified (not just unknown).

type.description: A classification from a controlled vocabulary (typically AAT).

identifier.description: URI in the controlled vocabulary (e.g. an AAT concept URI).

sourceLabel.description: Original label as given in the contributing source, before vocabulary mapping.

source.description: A citable document or authority that grounds an attestation.

relation.description: A entity-to-entity relation attested by an attestation (e.g. capital_of, successor_to).

relationType.description: URI of the RelationType authority (e.g. a vocabulary term for 'capital_of').

relationLabel.description: Human-readable label for the relation type.

metaAttestation.description: A reference to a target attestation and the nature of the commentary. Meta-types use SKOS concepts for vocabulary management.

targetAttestation.description: URI of the attestation being commented on.

metaType.description: URI of a SKOS concept defining the nature of the meta-attestation (e.g. contradicts, supports, supersedes, refines, bundles).

metaTypeLabel.description: Human-readable label for the meta-type (optional, for convenience).

attestation.description: A bundle of evidence linking a SpatialEntity to Names, Geometries, Timespans, Types, and Sources. The core unit of contributed knowledge in PLATO.

about.description: URI of the SpatialEntity this attestation is about. Required in attestation-centric submissions; implicit in place-centric submissions where the attestation is nested under its SpatialEntity.

properties.description: Attributes attested that are not names, geometries, timespans or types — populations, valuations, market days. Scoped by the attestation's own timespans.

relations.description: entity-to-entity relations asserted by this attestation.

meta.description: If this attestation is a meta-attestation commenting on another.

certainty.description: Overall certainty of this attestation, from 0.0 to 1.0.

sequence.description: Ordering index for attestations in routes or itineraries.

contributor.description: The contributor who created this attestation (URI or inline object).

modified.description: When this attestation was last modified.

contributorObject.description: A person, team, or automated process that creates attestations. ORCID required in WHG but optional in general ontology.

name.description: Full name for persons, team name for groups, descriptive name for automated processes.

orcid.description: ORCID identifier in full URI format (https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000). Preferred format for persistent identification.

affiliation.description: Organizational affiliation (Organization object, URI, or free text).

role.description: Role in the project or gazetteer.

url.description: Website or profile URL for the contributor.

identifier.description: Additional persistent identifiers (ISNI, VIAF, Wikidata QID, etc.). Format: 'TYPE:value' (e.g., 'VIAF:12345678').

organization.description: An organization to which a Contributor is affiliated. Lightweight class for organizational references.

@id.description: URI for this organization (preferably ROR, ISNI, or Wikidata).

identifier.description: Persistent identifiers: ROR, ISNI, Wikidata QID, etc. Format: 'TYPE:value'.

identityRelation.description: An assertion that two SpatialEntities refer to the same real-world entity. Distinct from scholarly entity-to-entity relations and from algorithm-generated Candidates.

identityType.description: Semantic strength of the identity assertion.

basis.description: Evidence or reasoning supporting this identity assertion.

assertedBy.description: Identifier or URI of the agent who made this assertion.

source.description: Authority providing evidence for this assertion.

promotedFrom.description: URI of the Candidate from which this was promoted, if any.

spatialEntity.description: A stable, persistent identity — typically a place, but generalised to routes, networks, administrative units, and other historical entities.

@id.description: Stable URI for this SpatialEntity. For new SpatialEntities not yet in the system, omit or use a local identifier.

label.description: A preferred display label (convenience field; canonical names come via attestations).

attestations.description: Attestations about this SpatialEntity (used in place-centric submissions).

identityRelations.description: Identity assertions linking this SpatialEntity to others.
